lines.text: The LORD became Israel's Savior, and the Angel of His Presence saved them in their distress.
After Israel rebelled, the LORD became their enemy, and they remembered the days of Aaron, when He divided the waters.
The prayer says Abraham does not know them, yet the LORD is their Father and Redeemer from Everlasting.
The prayer asks the LORD to come down so the seas quake and the nations tremble at His presence.
The prayer says the LORD is their Father, they are the clay, and He is the potter.
